Use case: stylized-concept. National cultural heritage travel illustration in the visual style of Day of the Tentacle adventure-game backgrounds with strongly exaggerated wonky angular architecture, crooked perspective and thick dark plum ink contours, combined with sculpted cel-shaded 3D volume, soft cast shadows, ambient occlusion and visible layered depth. NOT a realistic photo. Clear foreground/middle/background separation for parallax shader presentation, atmospheric distant scenery, bold silhouettes and rich organized details. Use real recognizable landmarks from the specified country only, regionally accurate natural animals in separate appropriate habitats. No invented landmark combinations presented as a literal place: this is explicitly a national travel montage. Natural animals without clothes, anthropomorphism or silly expressions. No octopuses, tentacles, fantasy creatures, silly characters or people. No words, lettering, flags, logos, watermarks or national emblems. STRICT EVERYWHERE even tiny skyline: no mosque, minaret, Islamic religious architecture, Islamic symbols, religious crescents, Islamic inscriptions or calligraphy. Civilian background houses only. Authentic Christian churches/cathedrals, Buddhist/Hindu temples, synagogues and ancient sacred monuments ARE allowed and encouraged when significant; do not exclude permitted landmarks merely because religious. Represent listed authentic regional sites without inventing extra religious buildings. Final composition is a broad representative regional selection, never all districts or exhaustive heritage. Keep every primary landmark roof and all animal silhouettes fully inside frame, with margins. Country: Congo (Rep.). Palette from supplied collection: #40CDDE #AC86ED #E984D8 #EFD359, supported by muted natural stone, wood and vegetation colors with purple shadows. Show these authentic landmarks in distinct regional clusters: Odzala Kokoua forest clearings (Cuvette Ouest); Nouabalé Ndoki rainforest (Sangha); Diosso Gorge (Kouilou); Basilica Sainte Anne (Brazzaville); Loufoulakari Falls (Pool); Pointe Noire railway station (Kouilou). Natural animals in appropriate separate habitats: western lowland gorilla, forest elephant. Local plants: raffia, limba. Small optional authentic craft/food detail: woven mats. Cover panorama3:1 final1500x500. Clear broad region clusters from left to right, animal foreground near lower-right and plants lower-left; ample upper breathing room, mountains and sky far behind.
CRITICAL medium: thick dark plum cartoon contours on EVERY silhouette, crooked angular architecture, broad chunky3D faceted pastel cel shading, no realistic fur or stone texture. Republic of Congo only, NOT DR Congo. Sainte Anne basilica steep green roof and Christian cross allowed. Pointe Noire civilian railway station Norman-inspired facade, no other religious buildings. Gorilla main lower-right fully inside frame, elephant separate rainforest clearing. No people at station. Panorama3:1.
